description: Flat metadata schema for record-level genomic, biosynthetic gene cluster, gene annotation, and alkaloid characterization data from medicinal plant biosynthetic pathway studies.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record within the dataset.

record_type.descr: Type of record represented by this row; examples: plant_genome, biosynthetic_gene_cluster, gene_annotation, alkaloid_characterization.

scientific_name.descr: Accepted binomial name of the plant species; example: Catharanthus roseus.

taxon_id.descr: Taxonomic identifier from a controlled vocabulary or database such as NCBI Taxonomy.

family.descr: Botanical family of the plant species.

common_name.descr: Common name of the plant species, if available.

specimen_id.descr: Identifier for the sampled plant specimen or voucher specimen.

voucher_information.descr: Herbarium voucher number, repository, or specimen reference used to verify plant identity.

collection_location.descr: Geographic location where the specimen was collected; include locality name or site description.

collection_date.descr: Date when the specimen or sample was collected.

tissue_type.descr: Plant tissue analyzed; examples: leaf, root, stem, bark, seed, flower.

developmental_stage.descr: Developmental stage of the sampled plant tissue or organism; examples: seedling, vegetative, flowering, mature.

cultivation_status.descr: Whether the plant was wild-collected, cultivated, greenhouse-grown, or field-grown.

biospecimen_notes.descr: Additional contextual notes about the biological specimen or sampling conditions.

genome_assembly_id.descr: Identifier for the genome assembly used in the analysis.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used; examples: Illumina, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy or library type; examples: short-read WGS, long-read WGS, Hi-C, RNA-seq.

coverage_depth.descr: Average sequencing coverage depth for the sample or assembly, in fold coverage (x).

assembly_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length in base pairs (bp).

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the genome assembly expressed as percent.

busco_completeness_percent.descr: Assembly completeness estimate from BUSCO or similar metrics, expressed as percent.

contig_id.descr: Identifier of the contig or scaffold containing the gene cluster or gene.

chromosome_name.descr: Chromosome name or number if the locus is mapped to a chromosome.

start_pos_bp.descr: Genomic start coordinate of the locus in base pairs (bp).

end_pos_bp.descr: Genomic end coordinate of the locus in base pairs (bp).

strand.descr: Genomic strand orientation; accepted values typically + or -.

gene_cluster_id.descr: Identifier for the biosynthetic gene cluster.

gene_cluster_name.descr: Human-readable name for the cluster, if assigned.

cluster_type.descr: Cluster class or biosynthetic category; examples: alkaloid biosynthetic cluster, terpene-associated cluster.

cluster_length_bp.descr: Length of the biosynthetic gene cluster region in base pairs (bp).

cluster_prediction_method.descr: Method used to detect or predict the gene cluster; examples: manual curation, antiSMASH, custom pipeline.

cluster_confidence_score.descr: Numeric confidence score or probability associated with cluster identification.

cluster_validation_status.descr: Whether the cluster is predicted, partially validated, or experimentally validated.

gene_id.descr: Unique identifier for the gene within the genome annotation.

gene_symbol.descr: Standard gene symbol or shorthand label, if assigned.

gene_name.descr: Descriptive gene name or product name, if available.

locus_tag.descr: Genome annotation locus tag for the gene.

gene_start_bp.descr: Gene start coordinate in base pairs (bp).

gene_end_bp.descr: Gene end coordinate in base pairs (bp).

gene_strand.descr: Strand orientation of the gene; typically + or -.

gene_product.descr: Annotated gene product or encoded protein description.

enzyme_class.descr: High-level enzyme class; examples: oxidoreductase, transferase, lyase, hydrolase, isomerase, ligase.

pathway_role.descr: Role of the gene product in the alkaloid biosynthetic pathway; examples: precursor synthesis, backbone formation, tailoring enzyme, transport, regulation.

functional_annotation.descr: Functional annotation describing inferred or curated biological function.

domain_annotation.descr: Protein domain or motif annotation, if available.

orthology_reference.descr: Reference ortholog or homolog identifier used for annotation, such as UniProt or RefSeq accession.

annotation_source.descr: Source of the gene annotation; examples: automated pipeline, manual curation, transcript evidence, homology-based annotation.

transcript_evidence.descr: Whether transcriptomic evidence supports the gene annotation or expression of the locus.

expression_level.descr: Expression level measure for the gene or cluster, if quantified; use the study's normalized unit.

expression_unit.descr: Unit used for expression_level; examples: TPM, FPKM, counts per million.

alkaloid_name.descr: Name of the alkaloid compound detected or characterized.

alkaloid_class.descr: Chemical class of the alkaloid; examples: indole alkaloid, isoquinoline alkaloid, pyridine alkaloid.

alkaloid_identifier.descr: External compound identifier such as PubChem CID, ChEBI ID, or InChIKey.

chemical_formula.descr: Empirical chemical formula of the alkaloid.

exact_mass.descr: Exact monoisotopic mass of the alkaloid, typically in daltons (Da).

molecular_weight.descr: Molecular weight of the alkaloid, typically in daltons (Da).

smiles.descr: SMILES string representing the chemical structure, if available.

inchi.descr: InChI string representing the chemical structure, if available.

retention_time_min.descr: Chromatographic retention time in minutes from LC-MS or related analysis.

m_z.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio from mass spectrometry.

fragmentation_method.descr: Mass spectrometry fragmentation or ionization method; examples: ESI-MS/MS, CID, HCD.

chemical_characterization_method.descr: Analytical method used to characterize the alkaloid; examples: LC-MS, GC-MS, NMR, HPLC.

compound_abundance.descr: Measured abundance or relative quantity of the alkaloid in the sample.

abundance_unit.descr: Unit for compound_abundance; examples: arbitrary units, peak area, ng/g fresh weight.

compound_purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the isolated compound expressed as percent, if applicable.

reference_standard_used.descr: Whether a reference standard was used for compound confirmation.

compound_validation_status.descr: Validation status of the alkaloid assignment; examples: putative, confirmed by standard, structurally elucidated by NMR.

biosynthetic_intermediate.descr: Name or identifier of a biosynthetic intermediate associated with the pathway, if observed.

upstream_precursor.descr: Immediate biochemical precursor associated with the pathway step, if known.

downstream_product.descr: Immediate product formed by the annotated gene or reaction, if known.

pathway_step_number.descr: Ordered position of the reaction or gene action within the inferred biosynthetic pathway.

evidence_type.descr: Primary evidence supporting the annotation or compound assignment; examples: genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, literature.

literature_reference.descr: Literature citation or reference supporting the annotation or chemical assignment.

external_accession.descr: External accession or database identifier related to the record, such as GenBank, ENA, RefSeq, UniProt, or MetaboLights accession.

analysis_date.descr: Date when the record analysis, annotation, or chemical characterization was performed.

curation_status.descr: Curation state of the record; examples: raw, processed, curated, reviewed.

record_notes.descr: Free-text notes for any additional interpretation, caveats, or provenance details.
